# Anuj Rastogi

> Full stack developer and data analyst building web products, REST APIs, automated testing tools, and Power BI analytics.

Official site: https://www.anujrastogi.in

## Profile

Anuj Rastogi is a developer at IntelligenceX and a B.Tech Computer Science graduate. He builds backend services, REST APIs and dashboards across multiple projects, including CSA (Cloud Security Alliance). His work spans Python, Django, React, Next.js, the MERN stack, REST API design and testing with Postman, and data analytics with Power BI and Excel.

## Key Areas

- Full-stack development with Python, Django, Next.js, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL
- REST API design, testing, and documentation
- Automated website testing with Lighthouse, Playwright, and axe-core
- Data analytics and business intelligence with Power BI, DAX, and Excel

## Featured Projects

- Rudra Website Analyzer: multi-engine website testing platform (Lighthouse, SEO, Playwright, axe-core accessibility) — https://rudraanalyzer.in
- Policy Mitra: client-built multi-tenant insurance management platform with customer, advisor, broker and admin workspaces — https://policymitra.online
